context: Ren and Mei plan a weekend, weighing options.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs (おそらく/さすが/あまりに/といった/少なくとも) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 週末は、おそらく晴れるみたいだよ。
lines.en: It'll probably be sunny this weekend.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm relaxed delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 海といった所に、行きたいな。
lines.en: I'd like to go somewhere like the sea.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle dreamy delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少なくとも、二日は欲しいね。
lines.en: We'd want at least two days.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 日帰りだと、あまりに慌ただしいよね。
lines.en: A day trip would be far too rushed.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さすが、君は計画が上手だね。
lines.en: As expected, you're good at planning.
lines.style: admiring young man voice, soft warm fond delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: おそらく、宿は早めがいいよ。
lines.en: We should probably book lodging early.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少なくとも、一泊は予約しよう。
lines.en: Let's book at least one night.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: bright woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
